questions.question: What was the mean hourly wage for dental hygienists in 2020?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_health_care_employment.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.startswith('Dental hygienists')].index[0]
result = float(df.iloc[row, 14])

questions.question: Which health care support occupation had a higher average hourly wage in 2020: physical therapist assistants or occupational therapy assistants?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_health_care_employment.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
ota_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Occupational therapy assistants'].index[0]
pta_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Physical therapist assistants'].index[0]
ota_wage = float(df.iloc[ota_row, 14])
pta_wage = float(df.iloc[pta_row, 14])
result = df.iloc[ota_row, 0].strip() if ota_wage > pta_wage else df.iloc[pta_row, 0].strip()

questions.question: Which three health care support occupations had the highest mean hourly wages in 2020?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_health_care_employment.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
start_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Health care support occupations'].index[0] + 1
end_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('Category not applicable|NOTES:', na=False)].index[0]
support_df = df.iloc[start_idx:end_idx].copy()
support_df[14] = pd.to_numeric(support_df[14], errors='coerce')
top3 = support_df.sort_values(by=14, ascending=False).head(3)
result = [str(x).strip() for x in top3[0].tolist()]

questions.question: How many health care support occupations had an average hourly wage of at least $20 in 2020?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_health_care_employment.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
start_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Health care support occupations'].index[0] + 1
end_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('Category not applicable|NOTES:', na=False)].index[0]
support_df = df.iloc[start_idx:end_idx].copy()
wages_2020 = pd.to_numeric(support_df[14], errors='coerce')
result = int((wages_2020 >= 20.0).sum())

questions.question: Did the number of employed registered nurses in the United States exceed 2.5 million in 2010?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_health_care_employment.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
rn_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.startswith('Registered nurses')].index[0]
emp_2010 = float(df.iloc[rn_row, 4])
result = 'yes' if emp_2010 > 2500000 else 'no'

questions.question: How much did the mean hourly wage for emergency medical technicians and paramedics increase between 2000 and 2020?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_health_care_employment.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.startswith('Emergency medical technicians and paramedics')].index[0]
wage_2000 = float(df.iloc[row, 8])
wage_2020 = float(df.iloc[row, 14])
result = round(wage_2020 - wage_2000, 2)
